description: This PHP class is an event subscriber for the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It listens for employee-related events (such as employee purge completion and employee deletion) and adjusts like and comment counts on shares and comments accordingly.

classes.name: BuzzAdjustCommentLikeCountSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber class that updates like and comment counts on social shares and comments when employees are deleted or purged.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber is listening to, specifically employee purge end and employee deleted events.

methods.name: onEmployeePurgingEnd
methods.description: Handles the event when an employee purge process completes, updating like and comment counts accordingly.

methods.name: onEmployeesDeleted
methods.description: Handles the event when employees are deleted, updating like and comment counts accordingly.
